_comment: Buildable troops (WO-453 Step 1, combat-only). A troop is a lightweight friendly fighter that hunts the nearest hostile and is itself damageable. Footman = melee bruiser (close + strike, tanky). Archer = ranged by REACH (attackRange 14 — no projectile visual yet). cost*/buildSeconds are authored for the later build-queue + army-storage steps (Step 2+) and are inert in Step 1. model maps to Resources/Heroes/<model> (Knight / Ranger), with a tinted-capsule fallback when the model is missing.
